meta.name: internal-controls-and-audit
meta.description: Designs and tests controls over financial reporting — segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, and preparing for audit. Use this to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, set approval thresholds, or assess where a small team's segregation of duties is genuinely broken.

copy.tagline: 设计财务内控并测试有效性,满足外部审计要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要为财务流程设计内控或准备外部审计
copy.tagline_en: Design and test financial reporting controls to meet external audit requirements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design internal controls for your finance team or prepare for an external audit.

howto.what: 根据你描述的流程,设计并测试财务报告相关控制,覆盖职责分离、审批限额、证据与审计准备;处理审计发现时修原因而非修个案。
howto.when: 当你要求设计流程控制、准备外部审计、回应审计发现等时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计报销流程的控制,重点看职责分离。
say.note: 会给出控制点、负责人和证据要求。

say.text: 按金额和风险设审批限额,并监控拆单。
say.note: 会给出限额分层和拆单监控方法。

say.text: 这个审计发现应该改原因还是只改这一笔?
say.note: 会按修原因原则给整改建议。

howto.what_en: Designs and tests financial-reporting controls: segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, audit readiness. For audit findings, fixes cause rather than instance. If segregation is impossible, suggests compensating controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, etc.

say_en.text: Design controls for our expense process, with segregation of duties as the focus.
say_en.note: Returns control points, owner, and evidence artifact.

say_en.text: Set approval limits by amount and risk, and monitor for splitting.
say_en.note: Proposes tiered limits and a splitting check.

say_en.text: For this audit finding, should we fix the cause or just this instance?
say_en.note: Advises remediation from the root cause.
